h08.

Two types declare a method named `RunOnce`, and only one of them is ever called from production code.

`(*s3presign.Runner).RunOnce` is declared at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` and it is invoked twice from production code: once directly at server startup by `(*Server).startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go:163`, and once on each 12-hour tick from `(*s3presign.Runner).Run` in the same file, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`.

`(*memopayload.Runner).RunOnce` is declared at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` and is dead code. Nothing calls it, and nothing even constructs the runner — `memopayload.NewRunner` has no callers either. The only part of that package used elsewhere is the standalone `RebuildMemoPayload` function, which `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls at lines 108 and 447.

| declarer | invoked? | caller(path) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `*s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43`) | yes | `(*Server).startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:163`); `(*s3presign.Runner).Run` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`) |
| `*memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) | no | none (no production or test callers) |

I searched the whole repository, not just Go files, so these are the only two declarations. Note that `server/runner/s3presign/runner_test.go` exists but does not reference `RunOnce`, so there are no test-only callers of either declaration.
